title: Enchantress

inlines.v: ENCH'ANTRESS, noun A sorceress; a woman who pretends to effect wonderful things by the aid of demons; one who pretends to practice magic. 1. A woman whose beauty or excellencies give irresistible influence. From this enchantress all these ills are come.
